description: This PHP source file defines the SugarChartFactory class, responsible for creating instances of chart engine classes based on configuration and parameters. It manages file inclusions for different chart engines and modules, providing a factory pattern implementation for chart object creation in the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: SugarChartFactory
classes.description: Factory class for instantiating chart engine objects based on configuration and parameters.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a chart engine class based on specified engine and module names, with fallback to default engine if configuration files are missing.
